Indian Business School Hosts AI Summit for Leaders

KLH Global Business School is hosting an AI leadership summit in 2026 to drive dialogue on the use of artificial intelligence. This event aims to bring together leaders from higher education institutions to discuss responsible and innovative AI integration. The summit is part of a broader effort to promote AI development in South Asia. The participation of MAXHUB in this dialogue highlights the importance of collaboration between industry, academia, and policy-makers in shaping the future of AI.
